ciPlatform: ubuntu-latest (v8 coverage is execution-path based; numbers are cross-platform deterministic)
policy: Coverage baseline gate — numbers must not regress. If a metric drops below the value recorded here (minus the v8 run-to-run tolerance), the gate fails (exit 1). A second assertion requires skipped tests == 0 so .skip / .todo cannot silently mask a regression. To raise the bar, update this file with freshly measured numbers + a new measuredAt/masterSha; never lower a number without an explicit baseline re-baseline decision.
toleranceNote: v8 coverage is execution-path based and mostly cross-platform deterministic, but a few async setup/teardown paths execute non-deterministically between runs. On @agenthub/shared two stable states were observed (lines 71.57 vs 71.59, a 2-statement / 1-function delta); web and desktop were bit-identical across runs. The 0.08pp tolerance absorbs this run-to-run variance with margin while still catching any deleted test that covers more than a handful of unique statements (a real cheat), which moves coverage by well over 0.08pp. If CI shows larger drift, raise this field — do not lower baseline numbers.

@agenthub/shared.coverageNote: Two stable v8 states observed locally: lines 71.57 (2 of 3 runs) and 71.59 (1 of 3). Baseline pinned to the conservative floor. tolerance field above absorbs the delta.

agenthub-desktop.configNote: Default vitest.config.ts includes src/__tests__/integration/edge-real.test.ts which needs a live edge-server binary; vitest.desktop-ci.config.ts excludes src/__tests__/integration/** — the same desktop unit subset CI runs via test:ci. Using this subset keeps the baseline honest and reproducible without a real Edge process.
